watch_list.title: Nvidia's Q4 and FY26 Financial Results Call
watch_list.rationale: Nvidia will discuss its financial performance, which could provide insights into the strength of the AI market and their strategic direction. Investor sentiment and the stock price of Nvidia and related companies may react significantly to this report.
watch_list.trigger: Nvidia holds conference call and releases Q4/FY26 results.

watch_list.title: AMD Server Segment Growth Realization
watch_list.rationale: AMD anticipates significant acceleration in its server business due to high demand for CPUs and accelerators. Monitoring developments here will indicate if AMD is successfully scaling production to meet this demand and capitalize on market opportunities.
watch_list.trigger: New reports or announcements from AMD or partners regarding server segment growth or supply chain scaling.

watch_list.title: Market Adoption of AI Mainstream Technologies
watch_list.rationale: Nvidia is actively trying to convince investors that AI is ready for mainstream adoption. Evidence of this shift, or lack thereof, will impact investor confidence in AI-centric companies.
watch_list.trigger: Reports or statements from enterprises about new widespread AI implementations or a broader market shift towards AI solutions.
